_comment: Command Center launch contract, version 2. S1 Pair C (W12). This is the DATA half of the S1 handoff: the server-accepted event/schema changes, the immutable run identity and the current-revision requirements that W12 implements in blackceo-command-center at S3. It is a contract document, not a JSON Schema: the validator lives in the consuming code and the approval half lives in approval_record.py + approval-record.schema.json. Nothing here authorizes an effect; it names what the server must accept and must refuse.

identity.consenting_actor_is: the authenticated person whose reply minted the approval
identity.routing_tenant_is: the company/workspace used for routing and data scoping
identity.rule: A tenant slug is never accepted where a consenting person is required, and a person is never accepted as the routing tenant unless the caller declares identity_kind='tenant'.

approval.minting_rule: Only the Command Center may mint a record, from the tenant's registered client identity and that client's own reply. An operator/worker bearer is never a client identity. A worker writing an approval-shaped JSON is not approval.

run_identity.rebind_rule: Once a run_id is bound to a (tenant_ref, installation_id, skill, launch_id) tuple, any event claiming a different tuple is refused and nothing is written. The current Command Center check compares launch_id only; S3 adds the other three.
collision_cases_to_refuse: two clients using the same launch slug
one client's second installation reusing an existing run_id
a later plan revision reusing the previous revision's run_id

current_revision.rule: A run advances to a higher plan_revision; it never moves back. Evidence produced at a lower revision is retained historically and may not close, complete or overwrite a unit at the current revision unless the dependency-invalidation logic proves that exact artifact unaffected.
current_revision.late_attempt_rule: An older attempt finishing after a retry or revision is recorded with its own attempt identity; it cannot replace the current output, release another attempt's budget, close a new revision's stage, or overwrite another tenant's run.

server_accepted_events.transport: authenticated per-client ingest token binding client_slug + host_shape + installation_id
server_accepted_events.unregistered_stage_visibility: A rejected or unknown stage is a visible delivery failure. It must not disappear into a successful synchronization count.
additive_changes_for_s3: attempt_id on item and stage events

known_mismatch.fix_at_s3: Register 'check' as an alias of 'checks' in the stage vocabulary, version the vocabulary, and only then enable any new emitter.

projection.overall_and_percentage: projected from the canonical current unit evidence, never supplied by the agent
projection.stage_percentage_label: separate from complete pages or complete launch units

outbox.outage_rule: A Command Center outage may not stop independent permitted local work, but the report must show synchronization unavailable/stale and may not claim remote acceptance.

server_refusals_required_at_s3: an event whose tenant_ref/installation_id/skill/launch_id contradicts the stored run identity
an event at a plan_revision lower than the run's current revision
an event carrying a field the accepted event contract does not name
an event naming a stage that is not registered for its skill
a report/review/complete transition with no launch-specific evidence
a transition that would preserve an already-green status after governing proof changed or a scoped approval was revoked
an approval record that declares authenticated_platform_record on a local/test transport
s3_coordinate_changes_in_command_center: src/lib/launch-approvals.ts: record the canonical kind, keep tenant_id and client_identity_ref as separate fields, keep flat cap fields as the wire and document the normalization, and version the row
src/lib/launch-ability-runs.ts: extend the run re-bind check from launch_id to the full immutable tuple, add plan_revision and plan_hash, keep stale evidence historical
src/lib/launch-run-events.ts: accept the v2 fields and reject an unknown field or stage
src/lib/launch-abilities.ts: register 'check' as an alias of 'checks' and version the stage vocabulary
src/lib/launch-runs.ts: project overall/percentage from unit evidence only
